Lemma
[The heat convolution solves the heat equation]

↗ def:heat-convolution-solution ↗ lem:heat-kernel-solves-heat-equation

\group Heat Equation

If $g\in C(\R ^n)$ has compact support, then its heat convolution satisfies \[ \partial _tu(x,t)=\sum _{j=1}^n\partial _{x_j}^2u(x,t) \] for every $x\in \R ^n$ and $t>0$.
Proof

\sketch Compact support supplies a common integrable bound for the required parameter derivatives. Differentiate under the integral and use $\Phi _t=\Delta _x\Phi $.

□
